key_difference: (D) patches only cleanupThreadData() with an uncapped swap-and-drain loop that unposts and deletes each event in the same pass, while (B) centralises the fix in QThreadData::clearEvents() (also used for secondary threads), unposts the whole batch before running any ~QEvent(), and caps the passes with MaxPasses. Under (D), a destructor that keeps posting loops forever, and a destructor that deletes a later receiver leaves a dangling pe.receiver.
